result:
I wrote `component.html` in the folder: a 1280px settings screen inside `#component`, using only the content you specified. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and the switches are untested.

- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't available as assets, so the page falls back to Helvetica Neue or Arial unless those fonts are installed. The heading and type will look different from the design spec without them.
- **Layout:** Each section has its title in the left four columns and its card in the right eight, on the 12-column grid with 64px margins.
- **Notifications:** The switches are native checkboxes styled with CSS, so they toggle without JavaScript. I set the first two on and "Product updates" off to show both states.
- **Delete Workspace button:** DESIGN.md has no red, so I used the quiet pill style (ink outline) on a Sand card instead of a destructive color.
- **Everything else:** All colors, sizes, radii and letter-spacing come from DESIGN.md, and button labels are in Title Case.
